name: Chassis Aberration
source:
A micro visual novel about a futuristic/sci-fi production line worker assigned to scan and analyze broken, synthetic humanoid shells, or "chassis". The scanning tool at their disposal can be quirky though...

[Edited from [url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/chassis-aberration]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于未来/科幻生产线工人被分配扫描和分析破碎的合成人形外壳或“底盘”的微视觉小说。不过，他们使用的扫描工具可能很奇怪……

[编辑自[url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/chassis-aberration]itch.io[/url]]
